mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a cool 48 degrees with clear skies near Fireman's Park. The moon is in its first quarter, and the International Space Station will be visible at 4:57 AM tomorrow as it travels from the West Southwest over Mount Horeb toward the East Northeast near Fitchburg and Madison. The overnight low will drop to 40 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is offering a Stormwater Utility Credit for property owners who use management practices like rain gardens or barrels. You can also become a Verona Sugar River Supporter for even more credit opportunities.

It is a busy couple of days in town! Tomorrow features Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee. Then, on Tuesday, October 21, you can enjoy trivia at Paddy Mac's, live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding the weekly police update, on October 15, an officer arrested a school bus driver for O W I while the bus was transporting students; fortunately, no injuries were reported.
We are currently closed for the night, but today's flavor was Caramel Peanut Buttercup. We will be back open tomorrow at 10:00 AM, when the flavor of the day will be Devil's Food Cake.
